newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Pharma Vision declines comment on Roche.
newsitem.headline: Pharma Vision declines comment on Roche.

text.p: Investment Trust Pharma Vision said in response to an enquiry that it had no comment on rumours that it was a seller of Roche Holding AG securities.
"We never comment on rumours," said Kurt Schildknecht a member of BZ Group, which manages Pharma Vision.
Rumours circulated in Stockholm on Thursday that a major investor in Roche has changed its shares for some of the Swedish drug group Astra AB's shares held by Investor AB.
But Astra said in Stockholm that it was not aware that Investor was reducing its stake. It also denied a rumour that Roche management was in Stockholm for a meeting with Astra today.
According to its 1996 first half report, Pharma Vision held 230,000 bearer shares, or 14.4 percent of Roche's total share capital, and about 74,000 Roche participation certificates.
Roche is often mentioned as a possible suitor when takeover speculation focuses on a large pharmaceutical group.
